description: This PHP source file defines the AuthProviderChain class, which manages a chain of authentication providers for the OrangeHRM system. It supports adding providers with priorities and authenticating using the chain of providers.

classes.name: AuthProviderChain
classes.description: Manages a chain of authentication providers, allowing addition of providers with priorities and executing authentication attempts sequentially.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds an authentication provider to the chain, ensuring no duplicates and no conflicting priorities.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Iterates through the registered providers to authenticate given parameters, returning true on success.
